# Pitoco developer switches - read when Pitoco starts. Empty on purpose.
# Pitoco mode (Configure > Switch 2 Rig) decides how Switch 2 games run; nothing here should
# override it, so test logs compare the two modes and nothing else. Every EDEN_* switch in effect
# is listed at the top of pitoco_dev.txt.
# One NAME=VALUE per line, # starts a comment. A variable set in the environment wins over this
# file, and %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt wins over this copy.
